## Adversarial findings — NOT RUN (backend config is malformed)

`faff adversarial-backends` exited 2: `adversarial.fallbacks` is not valid JSON ("Expected property name or '}' in JSON at position 1"). A broken config must fail loudly rather than quietly fall back to the primary backend alone, so the adversarial helper was not called. A human needs to fix the fallbacks value and re-run the review.
